method: Reviewed the actual8retained bilingual insolvency routes, earlier individual gaps and existing source guidance. Verified targeted current official indexed legislative text,2024executive thresholds,2019personal-insolvency scope and current financial-free-zone source boundaries. No complete downloaded51/2023PDF is claimed: direct official fetch403. Every addition states the applicable procedure; unsupported application or legal-outcome assurances are excluded.
materialFindings: Article 1 defines day as official working day; Article 247 small-debtor periods can be halved. No universal calendar-day count published.

Article 87 viability and repeat-application restrictions now answered, including the majority-approved-plan exception. Article 62 financing rules also govern restructuring through Article 94; prior secured consent is needed for equal/senior new security.
Articles 101 and 106 now distinguish debt-list grievance, trustee late admission, court escalation after refusal or ten working days without response, and distributions only after acceptance.
Articles 122–123 separately explain the liquidation final-claim invitation and finally rejected claims. Secured execution permission and objections are distinct from proof of debt and priority.
Article 179 priority is explained by collateral, privileged classes and ordinary debt; qualifying employee entitlement priority has a three-month salary cap. No recovery guaranteed.

Article 246(2) Arabic text and official MOEC English version both literally refer to not declaring the company bankrupt when reasonable loss-reducing precautions are proved. We do not silently rewrite that outcome into automatic personal immunity. Public answer accurately states the proof requirement; paragraph 4 express written-reservation exemption remains distinct. Judicial application to a specific liability case is a file issue, not an unanswered generic statutory question.

Closure recommendations concern defined public consultation/navigation purposes and known public questions, not every possible query, a practitioner procedural treatise, search ranking, or independent completion of excluded personal/DIFC/ADGM regimes.
